correctness.rationale: The quotient binary quartic Hasse coefficient calculation is exact; on the smooth open the three difference identities force pairs of equal squares. Each pairwise Hasse intersection is explicitly solved and the rejected constants/poles and smoothness exclusions are proved. The triple intersection factorization yields two F25-conjugate roots times four sign patterns; a Jacobian differential argument proves transversal triple crossings. The Euler-type component count yields exact q=5^m formulas for all m. Symbolic checks and exhaustive F5/F25 enumerations were executed from the packaged verifier files; finite checks are cross-checks, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Complete geometric low-rank classification for a canonical three-parameter genus-three family: six intrinsic rational strata, eight transverse triple crossings and uniform arithmetic counts for every extension. This is a natural codimension-two Ekedahl–Oort/p-rank question, not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine table lookup. It supplies information about exactly two supersingular quotient configurations absent from the prior superspecial-only analyses.
